lastCompletedStory.title: Wire the gate into the check:all spine and pin it in the gates manifest

nextStoryContext: US-009 wired US-008's check-test-tmpdir.ts gate into the check:all spine: added g('test-tmpdir', 'bun scripts/check-test-tmpdir.ts') to scripts/check-all.ts's GATES array immediately after test-sleeps (index 13 of 15, before skip-ratchet, per notes' placement instruction), added a CAM503_GATES = ['test-tmpdir'] block to test/gates-manifest.test.ts alongside CAM305_GATES with a matching describe test and updated the aggregate-membership/total-count tests (14->15). Also updated the two OTHER hardcoded-index/count assertions that referenced the manifest shape and were not named in the story's file-scope note but broke mechanically once the array grew: test/check-all.test.ts's 'has N gates in order' test (index list + toHaveLength) and its 'test-tmpdir gate: bun scripts/check-test-tmpdir.ts' per-gate command-shape test (new, mirroring the test-sleeps one), plus the shifted skip-ratchet index (13->14) and the onResults-entry-names test's expected array + its makeRecordingSpawn exit-code array (added one more 0 entry) -- all three live in the same describe blocks the story's notes pointed at, just not enumerated line-by-line. AC1's oracle command (grep+grep+bun test) verified green before and after; full bun run check:all was run TWICE end to end (once red on file-size, once green) -- the first run tripped the file-size ratchet on both touched-and-grown files (scripts/check-all.ts 485->486, test/check-all.test.ts 462->470, both by exactly the 1-2 lines this story's edits added), resolved per the CLAUDE.md rubric: raised only those two ceilings in scripts/file-size-budget.json to the gate's own measured content.split('\n').length count (confirmed via a one-off `bun -e` snippet, not wc -l), prepended a dated CAM-508/US-009 note to the top-level _ref, staged the budget file before re-running the gate. No other gate in the spine (coverage, debt-markers, dead-code, dup, agents-md, ci-parity) was touched by this story's diff. Full bun test: 6066 pass / 0 fail (unchanged count from US-008 -- this story added zero new runtime tests, only reshaped existing manifest/index assertions). bun run typecheck clean. This closes the last acceptance criterion of the CAM-508 PRD (root every test-scratch tmpdir call, migrate to derived-zero, gate it in check:all): all US-001..US-009 stories should now be complete -- the next agent should check prd.json for any remaining non-operator story before assuming more work is needed.
